parsed.rationale: Both `AsyncNotificationMessage` (Shared/Core/Sources/Core/Observation/AsyncMessage.swift:39) and `MainActorNotificationMessage` (Shared/Core/Sources/Core/Observation/MainActorMessage.swift:43) share 3 of 3 members identically — `name: Notification.Name`, `makeNotification(_ message: Self, object: Subject?) -> Notification`, and a `makeMessage` factory — differing only in whether the `Notification` parameter is annotated `sending` (for the async variant). A base PAT `NotificationMessage` can capture the shared contract (`name`, `makeNotification`, and a non-`sending` `makeMessage`), while `AsyncNotificationMessage` and `MainActorNotificationMessage` can refine it by adding or overriding the `sending`-annotated overload via protocol inheritance or a constrained extension, eliminating the structural duplication. Both records are production code in the same `Core` package with no test, codegen, or mock flags, making consolidation safe.
